name: Sentence Highlight
description: LOWER LEFT. VidRush's sentence highlight, refined: the spoken sentence types in a warm Playfair Display a letter at a time (no cursor) on up to three balanced lines; as its key phrase types, a marker in the video's accent wipes in under it and the phrase sets in dark italic on the marker (highlight, else the line's longest word). No bar, no underline. A soft marker stroke as it draws.

sample.text: Lake Powell is now at its lowest level since the dam was filled

name: Typewriter Lower Third
description: LOWER LEFT. VidRush's type-writer lower third: the line types in cream Courier Prime Bold (cap ~31 px) from frame 6, 2 frames a letter (the typing contract), a block cursor in the accent after it; the small line under it types at a letter a frame; the cursor blinks for 24 frames and goes. A clean typewriter for the typing span.

name: Kicker and Headline
description: LOWER LEFT. A small kicker in tracked accent caps (label, only when given), then the headline in Anton caps on up to two balanced lines, each word rising out of its own mask a beat after the one before, the key word in the accent (highlight, else the longest); a serif italic line under it when a subtitle is given. A soft text swoosh.

sample.label: The Colorado River
sample.text: The river that no longer reaches the sea

name: Kinetic Phrase
description: LOWER LEFT. A short line word by word, each landing out of a blur with a soft overshoot: the words that carry it in Anton caps, the small words (the, of, is...) in Playfair italic, the key word in the accent; one or two balanced lines. A very soft tick as each word lands.

sample.text: The lake is running out of time

name: Spoken Quote
description: CENTRE. VidRush's quote: the frame darkens softly at its edges, the quote in Playfair Display (cap ~44 px) fades in word by word as if spoken, between accent quotation marks, balanced lines centred; who said it (label, and subtitle: their role) small and tracked under a short accent dash once it is in.

sample.text: We have never seen the reservoir this low, and we are planning for it to fall further.
sample.label: Bureau of Reclamation official

name: Pull Quote
description: MIDDLE LEFT. An editorial pull-quote over a soft left-side darkening: a large accent quotation mark scales in, the quote in Playfair Display rises line by line out of clean masks, the key words (highlight) in accent italic; the speaker (label) and their role (subtitle) in tracked caps under it. A soft paper slide.

sample.text: Every drop that leaves this lake is a decision someone made decades ago.
sample.label: Hydrologist
sample.subtitle: Colorado River Research Group

name: Statement Card
description: RIGHT, vertically centred. An official statement on a dark glass card (a frosted fill that softens the picture, a hairline edge) sliding in from the right: the source as its header in accent tracked caps beside a small dot (label), the statement in Playfair italic word by word, how it was given under it (subtitle: 'IN A STATEMENT'). A soft swipe.

sample.text: Reclamation will take additional actions to protect Glen Canyon Dam operations and Lake Powell elevations.
sample.label: Bureau of Reclamation
sample.subtitle: In a statement

name: Name Card
description: LOWER LEFT. A name in Anton caps pulled into focus (blur 12 -> 0) as its tracking closes from wide to tight, one soft light passing across it in the accent; the role under it in tracked caps, the organisation or years in the accent under that. No bar, no box.

name: Question on Screen
description: LOWER LEFT. The question in Playfair italic (cap ~51 px) word by word out of a soft blur, on balanced lines; its question mark drops in last in the accent with a small settle. A very soft tick per word and a soft pop on the mark.

sample.text: So where did all the water go?

name: Contrast Statement
description: LOWER LEFT. Two lines that turn on each other: the first lands word by word in white Anton caps, then steps back (smaller, dimmed) as the second rises under it in the accent, larger ('THIS IS NOT A DROUGHT' / 'IT'S THE NEW NORMAL'). items [first, second], else text and subtitle. A soft swoosh on each line.

name: Ink Reveal Headline
description: LOWER LEFT. A headline in Playfair Display Bold (cap ~54 px) revealed like ink soaking into paper: a soft, uneven front of blots travels across each line (the second following the first); a small accent kicker over it (label, only when given). A soft whoosh.

sample.text: The Lake That Swallowed a Canyon
sample.label: Glen Canyon, 1963

name: Notice
description: LOWER LEFT. A tasteful warning, no red bar: an accent warning triangle draws itself, its mark pops in with one soft pulse ring, the warning as said in Anton caps beside it, a small line under it (subtitle). A soft pop.

sample.subtitle: Below 3,370 feet no water flows past the dam
